evidence.quote:
Effect of Spatial Information Usage During RL.
To further examine whether S-GRPO improves the
model’s ability to leverage spatial knowledge, we
evaluate model checkpoints

practical_problems.note: graph structure on/off during RL, measured on the etiological reasoning task (gap grows from 0.5 to 6.2); the evaluated task is reasoning QA, not forecasting, where STReasoner is only comparable (2.6% difference)

evidence.quote: We evaluate STReasoner in a strict zero-shot setting, where no finetuning is performed on this dataset.

practical_problems.note: synthetic-to-real transfer: trained only on synthetic data, evaluated zero-shot on a CausalRivers causal QA set; this is a causal QA test, not forecasting

automation_evidence.quote: Network SDEs-based multi-agent spatiotemporal data synthesis pipeline.

evidence.quote:
To validate the usefulness of the generated data
pairs and assess whether the textual descriptions are
accurately aligned with the corresponding spatiotemporal data

practical_problems.note: human labeling of 1,200 synthetic data-text pairs for alignment (1,064 high quality, 136 low quality retained out)

summary: Synthesizes graph-coupled time series with an SDE multi-agent pipeline and trains a TS-LM for spatio-temporal reasoning; gains are on a self-built reasoning benchmark with comparable forecasting, and a spatial-input study and a zero-shot real-data QA test probe context and transfer.
